'''Jakow Trachtenberg''' (17 June 1888 – 26 October 1951) was a Ukrainian-Jewish [[mathematician]] who developed the [[mental calculation]] techniques called the [[Trachtenberg system]].<ref name="book">{{cite book | year=1965  | title=The Speed System of Basic Mathematics | publisher=Pan Books Ltd | location=London | author=Jakow Trachtenberg, adapted by Ann Cutler and Rudolph McShane}}</ref> 

[[File:L'ingénieur et écrivain russe Jakow Trachtenberg, né à Odessa a été enregistré le 23 avril 1940 par la Gestapo Vienne base de données Gestapo résistance individuelle.jpg|thumb|Trachtenberg in a [[Gestapo]] mugshot, 1940]]

He was born in [[Odessa]], in the [[Russian Empire]] (modern [[Ukraine]]) to Jewish parents. He graduated with highest honors from the [[National Mineral Resources University|Mining Engineering Institute]] in [[Saint Petersburg|St. Petersburg]] and later worked as an engineer in the [[Obukhov State Plant|Obukhov arms factory]].<ref name=JT/> While still in his early twenties, he became Chief Engineer with 11,000 men under his supervision.<ref name=book/> The Tsarist government gave him the responsibility of supervising the formation of a well-developed [[navy]].

Trachtenberg was a dedicated [[pacifism|pacifist]]. When war broke out in 1914, he was instrumental in organising a society known as the Society of Good Samaritans. The idea was to train Russian students to take care of the wounded. It also had a special recognition from Tsar [[Nicholas II of Russia|Nicholas II]]. He was against violence of any sort despite having a leading position in tsarist arms production.<ref name=book/>

After the [[Russian Revolutions of 1917]], Trachtenberg fled to the [[Weimar Republic]] where he became critical of [[Nazi policies]]. He was imprisoned in a Nazi [[concentration camp]] during [[World War II]]. He developed his system of [[mental calculation|mental arithmetic]] during his imprisonment. He later fled to Switzerland. He died in 1951.<ref name=JT>{{cite web | url=https://www.svoboda.org/a/vychislyaya-trahtenberga/32485015.html |date=July 2, 2023 | title=Вычисляя Трахтенберга}}</ref>
